scope: Diagnose and remediate the rejected NACA 0012 zero-angle Gate 3 result without changing the benchmark, exact NASA TMR SSTm equations, or acceptance thresholds.

fixed_configuration.transport: Sutherland viscosity with molecular Prandtl number 0.72

phase_order.name: read_only_boundary_and_flux_audit
measurements: farfield mass-flux inflow, outflow, and net closure from phi
farfield area-weighted and extrema of p, T, rho, and velocity components
geometric segmentation of the single farfield patch into upstream, upper, lower, and downstream portions
convective momentum and total-enthalpy transport by segment
phase_order.decision_use: Localize whether shrinking the upstream and crossflow boundary changes conservation, thermodynamic state, or pressure loading. Measurements are diagnostic and grant no acceptance by themselves.

phase_order.name: domain_ladder
phase_order.initialization: Crop the frozen full-domain final fields by exact structured-row correspondence using an audited restart; do not interpolate or modify the full-domain source.
required_case_gates: all existing fixed final and final-window residual limits
phase_order.comparison: Compare admissible intermediate results with both frozen endpoints using the existing absolute limits Cd 0.0002, Cl 0.004, and CmPitch 0.0002. Preserve and withhold coefficients from any inadmissible case.
phase_order.decision_use: A monotonic thermodynamic or residual trend with boundary distance prioritizes farfield treatment. A distance-insensitive approximately ten-percent skin-friction excess prioritizes near-wall and solver-coupling diagnosis.

phase_order.name: pressure_energy_and_near_wall_localization
pressure_energy_checks: audit pinned rhoSimpleFoam momentum and energy equations against the declared NASA compressible formulation
audit p, T, U, k, omega, and nut boundary-condition behavior on inflow and outflow portions of the mixed farfield patch
separate pressure traction, convective momentum transport, and total-enthalpy transport
near_wall_checks: wall velocity gradient and wall shear
boundary-layer velocity profiles at available NASA stations
forceCoeffs viscous integration consistency with an independent surface reconstruction

phase_order.name: minimal_evidence_supported_correction
phase_order.entry_condition: Phases 1 through 3 identify a concrete implementation, boundary, discretization, or force-evaluation mechanism.
rules: predeclare the proposed correction and its falsifiable expected effect before executing it
change one mechanism at a time
do not tune coefficients or boundary values to the target drag
preserve every failed or null result

phase_order.name: gate3_revalidation
phase_order.entry_condition: A correction survives its predeclared mechanism test.
required_repetitions: zero-angle NASA CFL3D and Ladson force acceptance
phase_order.thresholds: Use the thresholds already frozen in the numerical-refresh and zero-angle acceptance artifacts; no post-hoc changes.

terminal_rules.pass: Gate 3 passes only if every repeated numerical gate and the frozen external force-agreement rule pass with admissible cases.
terminal_rules.fail_closed: If no defensible correction passes, or repeated Gate 3 evidence fails, update the verdict as rejected_not_validated with the localized cause and preserve all evidence.
terminal_rules.downstream_block: Do not run the 10-degree case, rocket CFD, optimization, novel-fin ranking, or OpenRocket coefficient transfer unless Gate 3 passes.
terminal_rules.domain_non_substitution: The 250c and 150c diagnostic cases cannot replace or relax the original approximately 100c domain acceptance check.
terminal_rules.gpu_non_substitution: Do not migrate solver version or GPU backend during diagnosis. Any future GPU work is a separate equivalence and performance goal.
